question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He __wanted to visiting__ the Golden Temple in Amritsar.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"wanted to visiting"** is incorrect in English grammar. The correct form should be "wanted to visit". (गोल्डन टेम्पल जाने की इच्छा थी) • **Example:** He wanted to visit the museum in the city. • **"wanted to visit"** is the correct form as per the English grammatical rules. (गोल्डन टेम्पल जाने की इच्छा थी) • **Example:** She wanted to visit her grandparents during the holidays. • Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: wanted to be visit** (गोल्डन टेम्पल जाने की इच्छा थी): This phrase is grammatically incorrect. • **Option 2: wanted to visited** (गोल्डन टेम्पल जाने की इच्छा थी): This phrase is also grammatically incorrect as the verb "visit" is in the past tense form "visited". • **Option 3: wanted to visitor** (गोल्डन टेम्पल जाने की इच्छा थी): This phrase is incorrect because "visitor" is a noun, not a verb. 4e:Tc51, The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
